messages.author: 1a7add4bd4e167cd
messages.subject: Error in if (empty(new)) return(data.frame()) :    missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
I'm trying to find the MLE's of the gamma distribution of the data at
the top of this call. I've stepped through the function and everything
seems to work out ok. But when I call qplot, this is the error message
I get. What am I doing wrong?

surv <- c(152, 115, 109, 94, 88, 137, 152, 77, 160, 165, 125, 40, 128,
123, 136, 101, 62, 153, 83, 69)
dgamma(surv, 1, 1/mean(surv))
devGamma <- function(x) {
stopifnot(is.numeric(x), all(x >= 0))
-2 * sum(dgamma(surv, shape=x[1], scale=x[2], log=TRUE))
}
est <- nlminb(c(1, (1/mean(surv))), devGamma, lower=c(0,0))
str(fdH <- nlme::fdHess(est$par, devGamma))
sqrt(diag(2 * solve(fdH$Hessian)))
8.799215+(5*2.731643)
8.799215-(5*2.731643)
12.893195+(5*4.118894)
12.893195-(5*4.118894)
fr <- expand.grid(shape=seq(0.5, 22.45743, len=101), scale=seq(0.5,
33.48766, len=101))
fr$dev <- apply(data.matrix(fr)[,1:2], 1, devGamma)
qplot(shape, scale, z=dev, data=fr, geom="contour", breaks=est$fval +
qchisq(c(0.8, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99, 0.999), df=2)) + geom_point(aes(est
$par[1], est$par[2]), shape=3, scale=2)

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: Error in if (empty(new)) return(data.frame()) : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
Ally, seems like breaks can't be in the qplot call. And it makes sense since it doesnt't tell in which axis you want the breaks. And est$fval is NULL and don't know if that's ok. See scale_x_continuous and scale_y_continuous to set the breaks.

HTH
Luciano
